name: Tome of the Stilled Tongue

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Cast a spell from the tome
powers.text: Once per dawn, cast a Wizard spell written in the tome without spending a slot (your next one uses no slot).

summary: A spellbook that, once a day, lets you cast a spell from it without a slot.
text: This thick leather-bound volume has a desiccated tongue pinned to the front cover. Five of these tomes exist, and it's unknown which one is the original. While you are holding the tome, you can use it as a spellbook and a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells. Moreover, while holding the book, you can take a Bonus Action to cast a spell you have written in this tome without expending a spell slot or using any verbal or somatic components. Once used, this property of the book can't be used again until the next dawn.
